## `src/firewall_analyzer/webui/static/js/pages/findings.js`

```javascript
// Findings — every finding, filterable by severity and category.
// Filtering, sorting and paging all happen server-side, so this stays fast on
// a rulebase far larger than the demo set.

import { api } from "../api.js";
import { el, clear, panel, empty, loading, fmtNumber, titleCase, sevBadge,
         svgIcon, toastError, debounce, modal } from "../ui.js";
import { getState } from "../state.js";
import { parseRoute, setQuery } from "../router.js";

const SEARCH_ICON = ["M11 19a8 8 0 1 0 0-16 8 8 0 0 0 0 16z", "m21 21-4.35-4.35"];
const PAGE_SIZE = 25;

export async function render(host) {
  const { current } = getState();
  if (!current || current.status !== "succeeded") {
    host.append(empty("No completed analysis selected"));
    return;
  }

  const q = parseRoute().query;
  const filters = {
    risk: q.getAll("risk"),
    issue_type: q.getAll("type"),
    search: q.get("q") || "",
    sort: q.get("sort") || "score",
    direction: q.get("dir") || "desc",
    offset: 0,
  };

  const toolbar = el("div", { class: "toolbar" });
  const chipRow = el("div", { class: "chip-row", style: "margin-bottom:.9rem" });
  const results = el("div");
  host.append(toolbar, chipRow, results);

  let facets;
  try {
    facets = await api.facets(current.id);
  } catch (err) {
    toastError(err);
    host.replaceChildren(empty("Could not load findings"));
    return;
  }

  buildToolbar();
  buildChips();
  await load();

  function buildToolbar() {
    clear(toolbar);
    toolbar.append(
      el("div", { class: "search-wrap" }, [
        svgIcon(SEARCH_ICON),
        el("input", {
          type: "search", placeholder: "Search rule name or description…",
          value: filters.search,
          oninput: debounce((e) => { filters.search = e.target.value; filters.offset = 0; load(); }, 280),
        }),
      ]),
      el("span", { style: "flex:1" }),
      el("a", {
        class: "btn ghost small", href: api.exportUrl(current.id, "csv"), download: "",
      }, "Export CSV"),
      el("a", {
        class: "btn ghost small", href: api.exportUrl(current.id, "json"), download: "",
      }, "Export JSON")
    );
  }

  function buildChips() {
    clear(chipRow);
    // Severity chips, worst first
    for (const level of ["critical", "high", "medium", "low", "info"]) {
      const n = facets.by_risk?.[level];
      if (!n) continue;
      chipRow.append(chip(titleCase(level), n, filters.risk.includes(level), () => {
        toggle(filters.risk, level);
        filters.offset = 0;
        buildChips();
        load();
      }));
    }
    chipRow.append(el("span", { style: "width:.8rem" }));
    // Category chips
    for (const [type, n] of Object.entries(facets.by_type || {}).slice(0, 8)) {
      chipRow.append(chip(titleCase(type), n, filters.issue_type.includes(type), () => {
        toggle(filters.issue_type, type);
        filters.offset = 0;
        buildChips();
        load();
      }));
    }
    if (filters.risk.length || filters.issue_type.length || filters.search) {
      chipRow.append(el("button", {
        class: "chip", style: "border-style:dashed",
        onclick: () => {
          filters.risk = []; filters.issue_type = []; filters.search = ""; filters.offset = 0;
          buildToolbar(); buildChips(); load();
        },
      }, "Clear filters"));
    }
  }

  async function load() {
    setQuery({
      risk: filters.risk, type: filters.issue_type, q: filters.search,
      sort: filters.sort, dir: filters.direction,
    });
    results.replaceChildren(loading());
    try {
      const data = await api.findings(current.id, {
        ...filters, limit: PAGE_SIZE,
      });
      results.replaceChildren(buildTable(data));
    } catch (err) {
      toastError(err);
      results.replaceChildren(empty("Could not load findings", err.message));
    }
  }

  function buildTable(data) {
    if (!data.total) {
      return panel("Findings", empty("Nothing matches these filters",
        "Clear a filter or widen the search."));
    }

    const header = (label, key, cls = "") =>
      el("th", {
        class: `sortable ${cls}`,
        onclick: () => {
          filters.direction = filters.sort === key && filters.direction === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc";
          filters.sort = key;
          filters.offset = 0;
          load();
        },
      }, [label, filters.sort === key
        ? el("span", { class: "arrow" }, filters.direction === "desc" ? "▾" : "▴") : null]);

    const table = el("div", { class: "table-wrap" },
      el("table", { class: "data" }, [
        el("thead", {}, el("tr", {}, [
          header("Severity", "risk"),
          header("Rule", "rule"),
          header("Category", "type"),
          header("Score", "score", "num"),
          el("th", {}, "Finding"),
        ])),
        el("tbody", {}, data.items.map((f) =>
          el("tr", { class: "clickable", onclick: () => showDetail(f) }, [
            el("td", {}, sevBadge(f.risk_level)),
            el("td", { class: "rule-name truncate", title: f.rule_name }, f.rule_name),
            el("td", { class: "muted" }, titleCase(f.issue_type)),
            el("td", { class: "num" }, el("strong", {}, f.score)),
            el("td", { class: "truncate", style: "max-width:38ch", title: f.description }, f.description),
          ])
        )),
      ])
    );

    const shown = Math.min(filters.offset + PAGE_SIZE, data.total);
    const pager = el("div", { class: "pager" }, [
      `${fmtNumber(filters.offset + 1)}–${fmtNumber(shown)} of ${fmtNumber(data.total)}`,
      el("button", {
        class: "btn ghost small", disabled: filters.offset === 0,
        onclick: () => { filters.offset = Math.max(0, filters.offset - PAGE_SIZE); load(); },
      }, "Previous"),
      el("button", {
        class: "btn ghost small", disabled: shown >= data.total,
        onclick: () => { filters.offset += PAGE_SIZE; load(); },
      }, "Next"),
    ]);

    return panel("Findings", [table, pager],
      { sub: `${fmtNumber(data.total)} matching` });
  }
}

function chip(label, count, active, onclick) {
  return el("button", { class: "chip", "aria-pressed": String(active), onclick }, [
    label, el("span", { class: "n" }, count),
  ]);
}

function toggle(list, value) {
  const i = list.indexOf(value);
  if (i >= 0) list.splice(i, 1);
  else list.push(value);
}

/** Finding detail: what was found, why it scored, and what to do about it. */
function showDetail(f) {
  modal((box, close) => {
    box.append(el("div", { style: "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin-bottom:.3rem" }, [
      sevBadge(f.risk_level),
      el("span", { class: "pill" }, titleCase(f.issue_type)),
      el("span", { style: "flex:1" }),
      el("span", { class: "panel-sub" }, `Score ${f.score}`),
    ]));
    box.append(el("h3", {}, f.rule_name));
    box.append(el("p", { style: "margin:.6rem 0 0" }, f.description));

    box.append(el("div", { class: "section-label" }, "Recommendation"));
    box.append(el("p", { style: "margin:0" }, f.recommendation));

    if (f.formula) {
      box.append(el("div", { class: "section-label" }, "How this score was reached"));
      box.append(el("p", { class: "mono", style: "margin:0" }, f.formula));
    }

    const details = Object.entries(f.details || {}).filter(([, v]) =>
      v != null && v !== "" && !(Array.isArray(v) && !v.length));
    if (details.length) {
      box.append(el("div", { class: "section-label" }, "Details"));
      box.append(el("dl", { class: "kv" }, details.flatMap(([k, v]) => [
        el("dt", {}, titleCase(k)),
        el("dd", { class: "mono" }, Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(", ") : String(v)),
      ])));
    }

    box.append(el("div", { class: "actions" },
      el("button", { class: "btn primary", onclick: close }, "Close")));
  });
}
```

## `src/firewall_analyzer/webui/static/js/pages/logging.js`

```javascript
// Logging & Audit — rules with logging disabled, worst first. An ALLOW rule
// with no logging is unauditable traffic, which is why it scores critical.

import { api } from "../api.js";
import { el, panel, empty, loading, fmtNumber, sevBadge, toastError } from "../ui.js";
import { getState } from "../state.js";
import { severityDonut, severityLegend } from "../charts.js";

export async function render(host) {
  const { current } = getState();
  if (!current || current.status !== "succeeded") {
    host.append(empty("No completed analysis selected"));
    return;
  }

  host.append(loading());
  try {
    const data = await api.findings(current.id, {
      issue_type: ["missing_logging"], limit: 500, sort: "score",
    });
    host.replaceChildren(build(data));
  } catch (err) {
    toastError(err);
    host.replaceChildren(empty("Could not load logging audit"));
  }
}

function build(data) {
  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

  if (!data.total) {
    frag.append(panel("Logging & Audit", empty(
      "Every analyzed rule has logging enabled",
      "Nothing to remediate here."
    )));
    return frag;
  }

  const byRisk = data.items.reduce((acc, f) => {
    acc[f.risk_level] = (acc[f.risk_level] || 0) + 1;
    return acc;
  }, {});

  frag.append(el("div", { class: "grid dash-2" }, [
    panel("Rules without logging", el("div", { class: "table-wrap" },
      el("table", { class: "data" }, [
        el("thead", {}, el("tr", {}, [
          el("th", {}, "Severity"), el("th", {}, "Rule"),
          el("th", {}, "Action"), el("th", {}, "Impact"),
        ])),
        el("tbody", {}, data.items.slice(0, 100).map((f) =>
          el("tr", {}, [
            el("td", {}, sevBadge(f.risk_level)),
            el("td", { class: "rule-name" }, f.rule_name),
            el("td", {}, el("span", { class: `pill ${(f.details?.action || "").toLowerCase()}` },
              f.details?.action || "—")),
            el("td", { class: "muted" }, f.description),
          ])
        )),
      ])
    ), { sub: `${fmtNumber(data.total)} rules` }),

    panel("Severity split", el("div", {
      style: "display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.7rem",
    }, [
      severityDonut(byRisk, { size: 160, stroke: 22 }),
      severityLegend(byRisk),
    ])),
  ]));

  return frag;
}
```

## `src/firewall_analyzer/webui/static/js/pages/new-analysis.js`

```javascript
// "Run New Analysis" — the wizard that replaces the command line.
//
// Vendor is chosen FIRST, before any file is picked — not guessed from headers
// after the fact. Two reasons:
//
//  1. The analyzer's own header auto-detection misidentifies a FortiGate export
//     as Cisco ASA (its Cisco indicator list is matched with any() rather than
//     all(), and is tested first), which silently reads the wrong columns and
//     skips disabled rules. Asking upfront sidesteps that bug entirely.
//  2. Once the export is known, the upload step can validate the real required
//     columns for that vendor (from field_mapping_schema.json, via /api/meta)
//     and tell the user immediately if the file doesn't match — rather than
//     running the analysis first and having them discover it in the results.

import { api } from "../api.js";
import { el, clear, panel, svgIcon, toast, toastError, fmtNumber } from "../ui.js";
import { navigate } from "../router.js";
import { loadMeta, selectAnalysis, refreshAnalyses } from "../state.js";

const UPLOAD_ICON = ["M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4", "M17 8l-5-5-5 5", "M12 3v12"];
const CHECK_ICON = ["M20 6 9 17l-5-5"];
const CROSS_ICON = ["M18 6 6 18", "M6 6l12 12"];

// A literal brick wall — stands in for vendors with no logo file (Generic/
// Other) and as the fallback if a logo image ever fails to load.
const WALL_ICON = [
  "M5 4h14a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v14a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V5a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z",
  "M4 9h16", "M4 14h16",
  "M12 4v5", "M8 9v5", "M16 9v5", "M12 14v6",
];

// null   = not chosen yet
// ""     = explicit "not sure, try auto-detect"
// value  = a real VendorType
const state = {
  vendor: null,
  file: null,
  headers: [],
  fieldCheck: null,
  allRequiredFound: null,
  project: "Default Project",
  label: "",
};

export async function render(host) {
  const meta = await loadMeta();
  state.vendor = null;
  state.file = null;
  state.headers = [];
  state.fieldCheck = null;

  const stepper = el("div", { class: "stepper" });
  const solutionPanel = el("div");
  const uploadPanel = el("div");
  const detectedPanel = el("div");

  host.append(
    stepper,
    solutionPanel,
    el("div", { class: "grid cols-2" }, [uploadPanel, detectedPanel])
  );

  paint();

  function chosenVendor() {
    // "" (auto-detect) is a valid, deliberate choice — not "unset".
    return state.vendor === null ? null : state.vendor;
  }

  function paint() {
    renderStepper(stepper, state);
    renderSolutionStep();
    renderUploadStep();
    renderDetectedStep();
  }

  // ── Step 1: choose the solution ──────────────────────────────────────
  function renderSolutionStep() {
    clear(solutionPanel);
    if (chosenVendor() !== null) {
      // Collapse to a summary bar with a change link, so the picker does not
      // dominate the page once a choice is made.
      const isAuto = state.vendor === "";
      const info = meta.vendors.find((v) => v.value === state.vendor);
      solutionPanel.append(el("div", { class: "panel", style: "margin-bottom:1rem;padding:.7rem 1rem" },
        el("div", { style: "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem" }, [
          el("span", { class: "eyebrow" }, "Solution"),
          el("strong", {}, isAuto ? "Auto-detect (not recommended)" : info.label),
          el("span", { style: "flex:1" }),
          el("button", { class: "btn ghost small", onclick: () => resetVendor() }, "Change"),
        ])
      ));
      return;
    }

    solutionPanel.append(panel("1 · Choose the solution you're analyzing", [
      el("p", { class: "panel-sub", style: "margin:-.3rem 0 .9rem" },
        "Pick the firewall this export came from. This decides which columns are read — choosing correctly avoids the export being silently misread as a different vendor's format."),
      el("div", { class: "grid cols-3" },
        meta.vendors.map((v) => vendorCard(v, () => pickVendor(v.value)))),
      el("button", {
        class: "btn ghost small", style: "margin-top:.9rem",
        onclick: () => pickVendor(""),
      }, "Not sure — try to detect it automatically"),
    ]));
  }

  function vendorCard(v, onclick) {
    return el("button", {
      class: "btn", style: "flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:.1rem;height:auto;padding:.85rem;text-align:left",
      onclick,
    }, [
      vendorLogo(v),
      el("div", { style: "font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem" }, v.label),
      el("div", { class: "panel-sub", style: "font-weight:400;white-space:normal" }, v.description),
      el("div", { class: "panel-sub" }, `${v.required_fields.length} required columns`),
    ]);
  }

  /**
   * Real vendor logos sit on a fixed white chip (see .vendor-logo-chip) so
   * they stay legible regardless of the app's own theme — third-party marks
   * come in every ink colour, and this app's cards go dark in dark mode.
   * Generic/Other, and any vendor whose image fails to load, gets the wall
   * glyph instead of a broken-image icon.
   */
  function vendorLogo(v) {
    const chip = el("div", { class: "vendor-logo-chip" });
    if (v.value === "generic") {
      chip.append(svgIcon(WALL_ICON, { size: 24 }));
      return chip;
    }
    chip.append(el("img", {
      src: `/img/${v.value}.png`,
      alt: `${v.label} logo`,
      onerror: (e) => { clear(chip); chip.append(svgIcon(WALL_ICON, { size: 24 })); },
    }));
    return chip;
  }

  function pickVendor(value) {
    state.vendor = value;
    // A file chosen before switching vendor is no longer validated against
    // anything meaningful — start the upload step over.
    state.file = null;
    state.headers = [];
    state.fieldCheck = null;
    paint();
  }

  function resetVendor() {
    state.vendor = null;
    state.file = null;
    state.headers = [];
    state.fieldCheck = null;
    paint();
  }

  // ── Step 2: upload ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderUploadStep() {
    clear(uploadPanel);
    if (chosenVendor() === null) {
      uploadPanel.append(panel("2 · Rule export",
        el("p", { class: "panel-sub" }, "Choose a solution above to unlock the upload step.")));
      return;
    }

    const drop = buildDropzone();
    const form = el("div");
    uploadPanel.append(panel("2 · Rule export", [drop, form]));

    if (state.file) {
      form.append(el("div", { class: "section-label" }, "Analysis details"));
      form.append(field("Project", el("input", {
        type: "text", value: state.project,
        oninput: (e) => { state.project = e.target.value; },
      })));
      form.append(field("Analysis name", el("input", {
        type: "text", value: state.label,
        placeholder: "e.g. PA-Primary-FW01",
        oninput: (e) => { state.label = e.target.value; },
      })));

      if (state.fieldCheck && !state.allRequiredFound) {
        form.append(el("div", { class: "notice warn", style: "margin-bottom:.9rem" }, [
          svgIcon(["M12 9v4m0 4h.01M10.3 3.9 1.8 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h17a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 3.9a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"]),
          el("div", {}, "This file is missing columns the chosen solution expects — check the list on the right before running."),
        ]));
      }

      form.append(el("button", {
        class: "btn primary", style: "width:100%",
        onclick: (e) => submit(e.currentTarget),
      }, "Run analysis"));
    }
  }

  function buildDropzone() {
    const input = el("input", {
      type: "file", accept: ".csv,.xlsx,.xls,.xlsm,.txt", hidden: true,
      onchange: (e) => e.target.files[0] && accept(e.target.files[0]),
    });

    const zone = el("div", { class: "dropzone" }, [
      svgIcon(UPLOAD_ICON, { size: 34 }),
      el("div", { class: "dz-main" }, "Drop a rule export here"),
      el("div", { class: "dz-sub" }, "CSV or Excel (.xlsx) — Excel is converted automatically"),
      el("button", { class: "btn", style: "margin-top:.8rem", onclick: () => input.click() },
        "Choose file"),
      input,
    ]);

    for (const evt of ["dragenter", "dragover"]) {
      zone.addEventListener(evt, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); zone.classList.add("over"); });
    }
    for (const evt of ["dragleave", "drop"]) {
      zone.addEventListener(evt, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); zone.classList.remove("over"); });
    }
    zone.addEventListener("drop", (e) => {
      const file = e.dataTransfer?.files?.[0];
      if (file) accept(file);
    });

    if (state.file) {
      clear(zone);
      zone.append(
        el("div", { class: "file-chip" }, [
          svgIcon(["M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z", "M14 2v6h6"]),
          state.file.name,
        ]),
        el("div", { style: "margin-top:.7rem" },
          el("button", { class: "btn ghost small", onclick: () => { state.file = null; state.headers = []; paint(); } },
            "Choose a different file"))
      );
    }

    return zone;
  }

  async function accept(file) {
    state.file = file;
    state.label = state.label || file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
    state.headers = [];
    state.fieldCheck = null;
    paint();

    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("file", file);
    if (chosenVendor()) form.append("vendor", chosenVendor());

    try {
      const info = await api.postForm("/analyses/preview", form);
      state.headers = info.headers || [];
      state.fieldCheck = info.field_check || null;
      state.allRequiredFound = info.all_required_found ?? true;
    } catch (err) {
      toastError(err);
    }
    paint();
  }

  // ── Step 3: what was detected ────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderDetectedStep() {
    clear(detectedPanel);
    detectedPanel.append(panel("3 · What was detected", buildDetectedBody()));
  }

  function buildDetectedBody() {
    if (!state.file) {
      return el("p", { class: "panel-sub" },
        "Columns are read and checked against the chosen solution's required fields before anything runs.");
    }
    if (!state.headers.length) {
      return el("p", { class: "panel-sub" }, "Reading columns…");
    }

    const parts = [
      el("dl", { class: "kv" }, [
        el("dt", {}, "File"), el("dd", {}, state.file.name),
        el("dt", {}, "Size"), el("dd", {}, `${(state.file.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`),
        el("dt", {}, "Columns"), el("dd", {}, fmtNumber(state.headers.length)),
      ]),
    ];

    if (state.fieldCheck) {
      parts.push(el("div", { class: "section-label" }, "Required columns for this solution"));
      parts.push(el("div", { style: "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem" },
        state.fieldCheck.map((f) =>
          el("div", { style: `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;color:${f.found ? "var(--ok)" : "var(--sev-critical)"}` }, [
            svgIcon(f.found ? CHECK_ICON : CROSS_ICON, { size: 14 }),
            el("span", { style: "color:var(--text)" }, f.field),
          ])
        )));
      if (state.allRequiredFound) {
        parts.push(el("div", { class: "notice", style: "margin-top:.8rem;border-color:var(--ok);color:var(--ok)" }, [
          svgIcon(CHECK_ICON, { size: 15 }),
          el("div", { style: "color:var(--text)" }, "All required columns for this solution were found."),
        ]));
      }
    } else {
      // Auto-detect was chosen — nothing to validate against.
      parts.push(el("div", { class: "notice warn" }, [
        svgIcon(["M12 9v4m0 4h.01M10.3 3.9 1.8 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h17a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 3.9a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"]),
        el("div", {}, "No solution was chosen, so columns cannot be checked in advance. Auto-detection may pick the wrong vendor and silently misread this file."),
      ]));
    }

    parts.push(el("div", { class: "section-label" }, "All columns found"));
    parts.push(el("div", { class: "tag-list" },
      state.headers.map((h) => el("span", { class: "tag" }, h))));

    return parts;
  }

  async function submit(button) {
    if (!state.file) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.replaceChildren(el("span", { class: "spinner" }), document.createTextNode(" Uploading…"));

    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("file", state.file);
    form.append("project", state.project || "Default Project");
    form.append("label", state.label || state.file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""));
    if (chosenVendor()) form.append("vendor", chosenVendor());

    try {
      const { id } = await api.postForm("/analyses", form);
      toast("Analysis queued");
      await refreshAnalyses();
      await selectAnalysis(id);
      navigate("/analyses");
    } catch (err) {
      toastError(err);
      button.disabled = false;
      button.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode("Run analysis"));
    }
  }
}

function field(label, input, hint) {
  return el("div", { class: "field" }, [
    el("label", {}, label), input,
    hint ? el("span", { class: "field-hint" }, hint) : null,
  ]);
}

function renderStepper(host, s) {
  const steps = [
    { name: "Choose solution", done: s.vendor !== null },
    { name: "Upload export", done: !!s.file },
    { name: "Confirm columns", done: !!s.headers.length },
    { name: "Run", done: false },
  ];
  const current = steps.findIndex((x) => !x.done);
  clear(host);
  steps.forEach((step, i) => {
    if (i) host.append(el("span", { class: "step-line" }));
    host.append(el("span", {
      class: `step${step.done ? " done" : ""}${i === current ? " current" : ""}`,
    }, [
      el("span", { class: "step-num" }, step.done ? "✓" : String(i + 1)),
      step.name,
    ]));
  });
}
```

## `src/firewall_analyzer/webui/static/js/pages/overview.js`

```javascript
// Overview dashboard — the executive view of one analysis.

import { api } from "../api.js";
import { el, panel, empty, loading, fmtNumber, titleCase, sevBadge, fmtDate,
         relativeTime, toastError, svgIcon } from "../ui.js";
import { severityDonut, severityLegend, rankedBars, trendChart, seriesLegend,
         ratioRing, cssVar } from "../charts.js";
import { getState } from "../state.js";
import { navigate } from "../router.js";

/** Audience presets. Each hides the panels that audience does not need. */
export const VIEWS = {
  executive: { label: "Executive", panels: ["kpi", "severity", "trend", "categories", "compliance"] },
  manager:   { label: "Security Manager", panels: ["kpi", "severity", "categories", "top-rules", "compliance", "recent"] },
  analyst:   { label: "Analyst", panels: ["kpi", "severity", "trend", "categories", "top-rules", "compliance", "recent"] },
};

let activeView = localStorage.getItem("fwa-view") || "analyst";

export function getView() { return activeView; }
export function setView(v) {
  activeView = v;
  localStorage.setItem("fwa-view", v);
}

const HEALTH_ICON = {
  Critical: ["M12 9v4m0 4h.01M10.3 3.9 1.8 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h17a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 3.9a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"],
  Poor:     ["M12 9v4m0 4h.01M10.3 3.9 1.8 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h17a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 3.9a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"],
  Fair:     ["M12 22a10 10 0 1 0 0-20 10 10 0 0 0 0 20z", "M12 8v4m0 4h.01"],
  Good:     ["M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14", "M22 4 12 14.01l-3-3"],
};
const HEALTH_CLASS = { Critical: "sev-critical", Poor: "sev-critical", Fair: "sev-high", Good: "sev-low" };

export async function render(host) {
  const { current } = getState();
  if (!current) {
    host.append(empty("No analysis selected", "Run a new analysis or pick one from History."));
    return;
  }
  if (current.status !== "succeeded") {
    host.append(renderPending(current));
    return;
  }

  host.append(loading("Loading dashboard…"));

  try {
    const [facets, topRules, recent] = await Promise.all([
      api.facets(current.id),
      api.rules(current.id, { limit: 10, sort: "risk", with_findings_only: true }),
      api.analyses(6),
    ]);
    host.replaceChildren(build(current, facets, topRules, recent.items));
  } catch (err) {
    toastError(err);
    host.replaceChildren(empty("Could not load the dashboard", err.message));
  }
}

function renderPending(a) {
  if (a.status === "failed") {
    return panel("Analysis failed", [
      el("div", { class: "notice bad" }, [
        svgIcon(["M12 9v4m0 4h.01M10.3 3.9 1.8 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h17a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 3.9a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"]),
        el("div", {}, a.error || "The run did not complete."),
      ]),
      el("button", { class: "btn primary", style: "margin-top:1rem", onclick: () => navigate("/new") },
        "Start a new analysis"),
    ]);
  }
  return panel("Analysis in progress", [
    el("p", { class: "panel-sub" }, a.progress || "Queued…"),
    el("div", { class: "progress-track", style: "margin-top:.6rem" },
      el("div", { class: "progress-fill", style: "width:45%" })),
    el("p", { class: "panel-sub", style: "margin-top:.7rem" },
      "This page refreshes automatically when the run finishes."),
  ]);
}

function build(a, facets, topRules, recent) {
  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
  const stats = a.stats || {};
  const summary = a.summary || {};
  const byRisk = facets.by_risk || {};
  const panels = VIEWS[activeView].panels;
  const show = (name) => panels.includes(name);

  const totalFindings = Object.values(byRisk).reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0);
  const critical = byRisk.critical || 0;

  // ── Analysis summary strip
  frag.append(el("div", { class: "panel", style: "margin-bottom:1rem;padding:.85rem 1.15rem" },
    el("div", { style: "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap" }, [
      el("div", {}, [
        el("div", { class: "eyebrow" }, "Analysis Summary"),
        el("div", { style: "font-weight:650;margin-top:.15rem" },
          `${a.project_name} • ${a.label} • ${titleCase(a.vendor || "unknown")}`),
      ]),
      el("span", { style: "flex:1" }),
      el("span", { class: "pill state-succeeded" }, "Completed"),
      el("span", { class: "panel-sub" }, fmtDate(a.created_at)),
    ])
  ));

  // ── KPI tiles
  if (show("kpi")) {
    const health = summary.overall_health || "—";
    frag.append(el("div", { class: "kpi-grid" }, [
      kpi("Overall Risk Health",
        el("div", { class: `kpi-health ${HEALTH_CLASS[health] || ""}` }, [
          svgIcon(HEALTH_ICON[health] || HEALTH_ICON.Fair, { size: 26 }),
          el("span", { class: "kpi-value", style: "font-size:1.6rem" }, health),
        ]),
        health === "Good" ? "No critical findings" : "Immediate attention required"),
      kpi("Total Findings", el("div", { class: "kpi-value" }, fmtNumber(totalFindings)),
        "Across all categories"),
      kpi("Critical Findings", el("div", { class: "kpi-value sev-critical" }, fmtNumber(critical)),
        totalFindings ? `${((critical / totalFindings) * 100).toFixed(1)}% of total findings` : "—"),
      kpi("Active Rules Analyzed", el("div", { class: "kpi-value brand" }, fmtNumber(stats.total_rules)),
        `Out of ${fmtNumber(stats.all_rules_total)} total rules`),
      kpi("High Risk Rules",
        el("div", { class: "kpi-value" }, fmtNumber(facets.rule_bands?.high || 0)),
        `score ≥ 70 of ${fmtNumber(stats.total_rules)} analyzed`),
    ]));
  }

  // ── Charts row
  const chartRow = el("div", { class: "grid dash-3", style: "margin-bottom:1rem" });

  if (show("severity")) {
    chartRow.append(panel("Findings by Severity",
      el("div", { class: "chart-wrap" }, [
        severityDonut(byRisk),
        severityLegend(byRisk),
      ])
    ));
  }

  if (show("trend")) {
    const trend = buildTrend(recent);
    chartRow.append(panel("Findings Trend",
      trend
        ? [trendChart(trend.labels, trend.series), seriesLegend(trend.series)]
        : empty("Not enough history", "Run this ruleset again to see movement over time."),
      { sub: trend ? `last ${trend.labels.length} runs` : null }
    ));
  }

  if (show("categories")) {
    const rows = Object.entries(facets.by_type || {})
      .map(([key, value]) => ({ label: titleCase(key), value }));
    chartRow.append(panel("Top Finding Categories",
      rows.length ? rankedBars(rows, { max: 6 }) : empty("No findings"),
      { sub: "by count" }
    ));
  }
  if (chartRow.children.length) frag.append(chartRow);

  // ── Tables row
  const tableRow = el("div", { class: "grid dash-2" });

  if (show("top-rules")) {
    tableRow.append(panel("Highest Risk Rules",
      topRules.items.length ? topRulesTable(a, topRules.items) : empty("No rules with findings"),
      {
        actions: el("button", { class: "btn ghost small", onclick: () => navigate("/rules") }, "View all"),
        sub: `top ${Math.min(10, topRules.items.length)} of ${fmtNumber(topRules.total)}`,
      }
    ));
  }

  const side = el("div", { class: "grid" });
  if (show("compliance")) {
    // Rules are bucketed by the analyzer's own risk thresholds (70 / 40), not
    // by "has any finding": several analyzers emit a score-1 finding to record
    // that a rule is *compliant*, so almost every rule has one and that metric
    // would read 0% clean on a healthy rulebase.
    const bands = facets.rule_bands || {};
    const total = bands.total || 0;
    const belowThreshold = (bands.clean || 0) + (bands.low || 0);
    side.append(panel("Rule Hygiene",
      el("div", { style: "display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.6rem" }, [
        ratioRing(belowThreshold, total),
        el("div", { class: "chart-legend", style: "width:100%" }, [
          legendRow("High risk (score ≥ 70)", bands.high || 0, cssVar("--sev-critical")),
          legendRow("Medium (40–69)", bands.medium || 0, cssVar("--sev-medium")),
          legendRow("Low (< 40)", bands.low || 0, cssVar("--sev-low")),
          legendRow("No findings", bands.clean || 0, cssVar("--ok")),
          legendRow("Disabled (excluded)", stats.disabled_rules_excluded || 0, cssVar("--muted")),
        ]),
      ]),
      { sub: "by rule risk score" }
    ));
  }
  if (show("recent")) {
    side.append(panel("Recent Analyses", recentList(recent),
      { actions: el("button", { class: "btn ghost small", onclick: () => navigate("/analyses") }, "All") }));
  }
  if (side.children.length) tableRow.append(side);
  if (tableRow.children.length) frag.append(tableRow);

  return frag;
}

function kpi(label, valueNode, foot) {
  return el("div", { class: "kpi" }, [
    el("span", { class: "kpi-label" }, label),
    valueNode,
    el("span", { class: "kpi-foot" }, foot),
  ]);
}

function legendRow(label, value, color) {
  return el("span", { class: "item" }, [
    el("span", { class: "swatch", style: `background:${color}` }),
    el("span", { class: "lg-label" }, label),
    el("span", { class: "lg-value" }, fmtNumber(value)),
  ]);
}

/**
 * Trend across previous successful runs. Real history only — if there are
 * fewer than two runs this returns null and the panel says so, rather than
 * drawing an invented line.
 */
function buildTrend(recent) {
  const done = recent
    .filter((r) => r.status === "succeeded" && r.summary)
    .slice(0, 8)
    .reverse();
  if (done.length < 2) return null;

  return {
    labels: done.map((r) => new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString(undefined,
      { month: "short", day: "numeric" })),
    series: [
      { name: "Total findings", color: cssVar("--series-1"),
        values: done.map((r) => r.summary.total_issues || 0) },
      { name: "Critical + high", color: cssVar("--series-2"),
        values: done.map((r) => (r.summary.critical_issues || 0) + (r.summary.high_risk_issues || 0)) },
    ],
  };
}

function topRulesTable(analysis, rules) {
  return el("div", { class: "table-wrap" },
    el("table", { class: "data" }, [
      el("thead", {}, el("tr", {}, [
        el("th", { class: "num" }, "#"),
        el("th", {}, "Rule"),
        el("th", {}, "Action"),
        el("th", { class: "num" }, "Risk"),
        el("th", { class: "num" }, "Findings"),
      ])),
      el("tbody", {}, rules.map((r) =>
        el("tr", {
          class: "clickable",
          onclick: () => navigate(`/rules?rule=${encodeURIComponent(r.rule_id)}`),
        }, [
          el("td", { class: "num muted" }, r.seq),
          el("td", { class: "rule-name" }, r.name),
          el("td", {}, el("span", { class: `pill ${r.action}` }, r.action)),
          el("td", { class: "num" }, el("strong", {}, fmtNumber(r.risk_score))),
          el("td", { class: "num muted" }, r.finding_count),
        ])
      )),
    ])
  );
}

function recentList(items) {
  if (!items.length) return empty("No analyses yet");
  return el("div", { style: "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.1rem" },
    items.slice(0, 6).map((r) =>
      el("button", {
        class: "side-link",
        style: "color:var(--text);width:100%;text-align:left",
        onclick: async () => {
          const { selectAnalysis } = await import("../state.js");
          await selectAnalysis(r.id);
          navigate("/overview");
        },
      }, [
        el("div", { style: "flex:1;min-width:0" }, [
          el("div", { class: "truncate", style: "font-weight:640;max-width:14rem" }, r.label),
          el("div", { class: "panel-sub" }, `${relativeTime(r.created_at)} • ${titleCase(r.vendor || "—")}`),
        ]),
        r.status === "succeeded" && r.summary
          ? sevBadge(r.summary.critical_issues > 0 ? "critical" : "low")
          : el("span", { class: `pill state-${r.status}` }, r.status),
      ])
    )
  );
}
```

```javascript
// Full Report — the analyzer's own HTML report, embedded. It stays the record
// of truth for a handover, so it is shown as generated rather than re-skinned.

import { api } from "../api.js";
import { el, empty, panel } from "../ui.js";
import { getState } from "../state.js";

export async function render(host) {
  const { current } = getState();
  if (!current || current.status !== "succeeded") {
    host.append(empty("No completed analysis selected"));
    return;
  }

  const url = api.reportUrl(current.id);
  host.append(panel("Full analyzer report", [
    el("p", { class: "panel-sub", style: "margin:-.4rem 0 .8rem" },
      "The complete generated report, including the scoring methodology and every rule expanded."),
    el("iframe", {
      src: url, title: "Firewall analysis report",
      style: "width:100%;height:75vh;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff",
    }),
  ], {
    actions: el("a", { class: "btn ghost small", href: url, target: "_blank", rel: "noopener" },
      "Open in new tab"),
  }));
}
```

```javascript
// Rule Explorer — every rule in the file, including the disabled and
// filtered-out ones the analyzers never scored, so "why isn't this flagged?"
// has an answer on screen.

import { api } from "../api.js";
import { el, clear, panel, empty, loading, fmtNumber, titleCase, sevBadge, tagList,
         svgIcon, toastError, debounce, modal } from "../ui.js";
import { getState } from "../state.js";
import { parseRoute, setQuery } from "../router.js";

const SEARCH_ICON = ["M11 19a8 8 0 1 0 0-16 8 8 0 0 0 0 16z", "m21 21-4.35-4.35"];
const PAGE_SIZE = 25;

export async function render(host) {
  const { current } = getState();
  if (!current || current.status !== "succeeded") {
    host.append(empty("No completed analysis selected"));
    return;
  }

  const q = parseRoute().query;
  const filters = {
    search: q.get("q") || "",
    action: q.get("action") || "",
    with_findings_only: q.get("flagged") === "1",
    sort: q.get("sort") || "risk",
    direction: q.get("dir") || "desc",
    offset: 0,
  };

  const toolbar = el("div", { class: "toolbar" });
  const results = el("div");
  host.append(toolbar, results);

  buildToolbar();
  await load();

  // Deep link from the dashboard: /rules?rule=<id> opens that rule directly.
  const deepLink = q.get("rule");
  if (deepLink) openRule(current.id, deepLink);

  function buildToolbar() {
    clear(toolbar);
    toolbar.append(
      el("div", { class: "search-wrap" }, [
        svgIcon(SEARCH_ICON),
        el("input", {
          type: "search", placeholder: "Search name, ID or address…", value: filters.search,
          oninput: debounce((e) => { filters.search = e.target.value; filters.offset = 0; load(); }, 280),
        }),
      ]),
      el("select", {
        onchange: (e) => { filters.action = e.target.value; filters.offset = 0; load(); },
        style: "font:inherit;font-size:.84rem;padding:.44rem .6rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text)",
      }, [
        el("option", { value: "" }, "All actions"),
        el("option", { value: "allow", selected: filters.action === "allow" }, "Allow only"),
        el("option", { value: "deny", selected: filters.action === "deny" }, "Deny only"),
      ]),
      el("button", {
        class: "chip", "aria-pressed": String(filters.with_findings_only),
        onclick: () => {
          filters.with_findings_only = !filters.with_findings_only;
          filters.offset = 0; buildToolbar(); load();
        },
      }, "With findings only")
    );
  }

  async function load() {
    setQuery({
      q: filters.search, action: filters.action,
      flagged: filters.with_findings_only ? "1" : "", sort: filters.sort, dir: filters.direction,
    });
    results.replaceChildren(loading());
    try {
      const data = await api.rules(current.id, { ...filters, limit: PAGE_SIZE });
      results.replaceChildren(buildTable(data));
    } catch (err) {
      toastError(err);
      results.replaceChildren(empty("Could not load rules", err.message));
    }
  }

  function buildTable(data) {
    if (!data.total) return panel("Rules", empty("No rules match these filters"));

    const header = (label, key, cls = "") =>
      el("th", {
        class: `sortable ${cls}`,
        onclick: () => {
          filters.direction = filters.sort === key && filters.direction === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc";
          filters.sort = key; filters.offset = 0; load();
        },
      }, [label, filters.sort === key
        ? el("span", { class: "arrow" }, filters.direction === "desc" ? "▾" : "▴") : null]);

    const table = el("div", { class: "table-wrap" },
      el("table", { class: "data" }, [
        el("thead", {}, el("tr", {}, [
          header("#", "seq", "num"),
          header("Rule", "name"),
          header("Action", "action"),
          el("th", {}, "Source"),
          el("th", {}, "Destination"),
          el("th", {}, "Service"),
          header("Risk", "risk", "num"),
          header("Findings", "findings", "num"),
        ])),
        el("tbody", {}, data.items.map((r) =>
          el("tr", {
            class: "clickable",
            style: r.disabled ? "opacity:.5" : null,
            onclick: () => openRule(current.id, r.rule_id),
          }, [
            el("td", { class: "num muted" }, r.seq),
            el("td", {}, [
              el("div", { class: "rule-name truncate", style: "max-width:20ch", title: r.name }, r.name),
              r.disabled ? el("span", { class: "pill" }, "disabled") : null,
            ]),
            el("td", {}, el("span", { class: `pill ${r.action}` }, r.action)),
            el("td", {}, tagList(r.src_addresses, { max: 2 })),
            el("td", {}, tagList(r.dst_addresses, { max: 2 })),
            el("td", {}, tagList(r.services, { max: 2 })),
            el("td", { class: "num" }, r.risk_score ? el("strong", {}, r.risk_score) : el("span", { class: "muted" }, "—")),
            el("td", { class: "num muted" }, r.finding_count || "—"),
          ])
        )),
      ])
    );

    const shown = Math.min(filters.offset + PAGE_SIZE, data.total);
    const pager = el("div", { class: "pager" }, [
      `${fmtNumber(filters.offset + 1)}–${fmtNumber(shown)} of ${fmtNumber(data.total)}`,
      el("button", {
        class: "btn ghost small", disabled: filters.offset === 0,
        onclick: () => { filters.offset = Math.max(0, filters.offset - PAGE_SIZE); load(); },
      }, "Previous"),
      el("button", {
        class: "btn ghost small", disabled: shown >= data.total,
        onclick: () => { filters.offset += PAGE_SIZE; load(); },
      }, "Next"),
    ]);

    return panel("Rules", [table, pager], { sub: `${fmtNumber(data.total)} rules` });
  }
}

async function openRule(analysisId, ruleId) {
  let rule;
  try {
    rule = await api.rule(analysisId, ruleId);
  } catch (err) {
    toastError(err);
    return;
  }

  modal((box, close) => {
    box.append(el("div", { style: "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.3rem" }, [
      el("span", { class: `pill ${rule.action}` }, rule.action),
      rule.disabled ? el("span", { class: "pill" }, "disabled") : null,
      el("span", { style: "flex:1" }),
      el("span", { class: "panel-sub" }, `Risk score ${rule.risk_score}`),
    ]));
    box.append(el("h3", {}, rule.name));
    box.append(el("p", { class: "modal-sub" }, `Rule ID ${rule.rule_id} · position #${rule.seq}`));

    box.append(el("div", { class: "section-label" }, "Match criteria"));
    box.append(el("dl", { class: "kv" }, [
      el("dt", {}, "Source zones"), el("dd", {}, tagList(rule.src_zones, { max: 8 })),
      el("dt", {}, "Source"), el("dd", {}, tagList(rule.src_addresses, { max: 8 })),
      el("dt", {}, "Destination zones"), el("dd", {}, tagList(rule.dst_zones, { max: 8 })),
      el("dt", {}, "Destination"), el("dd", {}, tagList(rule.dst_addresses, { max: 8 })),
      el("dt", {}, "Services"), el("dd", {}, tagList(rule.services, { max: 8 })),
      el("dt", {}, "Applications"), el("dd", {}, tagList(rule.applications, { max: 8 })),
      el("dt", {}, "Logging"), el("dd", {}, rule.logging || el("span", { class: "muted" }, "not set")),
      el("dt", {}, "Usage"), el("dd", {}, rule.rule_usage || el("span", { class: "muted" }, "—")),
    ]));

    box.append(el("div", { class: "section-label" },
      `Findings (${rule.findings.length})`));
    if (!rule.findings.length) {
      box.append(el("p", { class: "muted", style: "margin:0" },
        rule.disabled
          ? "Disabled rules are excluded from analysis."
          : "No findings were raised against this rule."));
    } else {
      box.append(el("div", { class: "table-wrap" },
        el("table", { class: "data" }, [
          el("thead", {}, el("tr", {}, [
            el("th", {}, "Severity"), el("th", {}, "Category"),
            el("th", { class: "num" }, "Score"), el("th", {}, "Description"),
          ])),
          el("tbody", {}, rule.findings.map((f) =>
            el("tr", {}, [
              el("td", {}, sevBadge(f.risk_level)),
              el("td", { class: "muted" }, titleCase(f.issue_type)),
              el("td", { class: "num" }, f.score),
              el("td", {}, f.description),
            ])
          )),
        ])
      ));
    }

    box.append(el("div", { class: "actions" },
      el("button", { class: "btn primary", onclick: close }, "Close")));
  });
}
```

## `src/firewall_analyzer/webui/static/js/pages/settings.js`

```javascript
// Settings — what this deployment is pointed at, and the analyzer quirks the
// team needs to know about.

import { el, panel, toast } from "../ui.js";
import { loadMeta } from "../state.js";

export async function render(host) {
  const meta = await loadMeta();

  host.append(panel("Appearance", el("div", { class: "toolbar", style: "margin:0" }, [
    el("span", { class: "panel-sub" }, "Theme"),
    el("button", {
      class: "btn small",
      onclick: () => setTheme("light"),
    }, "Light"),
    el("button", { class: "btn small", onclick: () => setTheme("dark") }, "Dark"),
    el("button", {
      class: "btn small ghost",
      onclick: () => {
        localStorage.removeItem("fwa-theme");
        document.documentElement.dataset.theme =
          window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light";
        toast("Following system theme");
      },
    }, "Match system"),
  ])));

  host.append(el("div", { style: "height:1rem" }));

  host.append(panel("Supported vendors", el("div", { class: "tag-list" },
    meta.vendors.map((v) => el("span", { class: "tag" }, v.label))
  ), { sub: "column mappings are defined in field_mapping_schema.json" }));

  host.append(el("div", { style: "height:1rem" }));

  host.append(panel("Known analyzer behaviour", el("div", { style: "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.8rem" }, [
    note("Vendor auto-detection is unreliable",
      "A FortiGate export is claimed by the Cisco ASA matcher, which tests its indicators with any() rather than all() and runs first. The wrong column mapping is then used and disabled rules are audited as if live. The wizard therefore asks for the vendor explicitly."),
    note("Application risk scoring depends on the config in use",
      "This service loads the full scoring config that ships inside the package. Running the CLI from the repo root instead picks up a minimal analysis_config.json that disables application risk scoring, which drops roughly a hundred findings on the sample ruleset."),
    note("Excel input is converted server-side",
      "The analyzer's parser reads CSV only; handing it a .xlsx produces a UTF-8 decode error. Uploads are converted before parsing, so either format works here."),
  ])));
}

function note(title, body) {
  return el("div", { class: "notice" }, el("div", {}, [
    el("div", { style: "font-weight:650;margin-bottom:.2rem" }, title),
    el("div", { class: "muted" }, body),
  ]));
}

function setTheme(t) {
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = t;
  localStorage.setItem("fwa-theme", t);
  toast(`${t[0].toUpperCase() + t.slice(1)} theme applied`);
}
```

## `src/firewall_analyzer/webui/static/js/pages/zones.js`

```javascript
// Zone Analysis — the zone-to-zone traffic matrix the analyzer builds by
// resolving rule addresses against the configured subnets.

import { el, panel, empty, fmtNumber } from "../ui.js";
import { getState } from "../state.js";

export async function render(host) {
  const { current } = getState();
  if (!current || current.status !== "succeeded") {
    host.append(empty("No completed analysis selected"));
    return;
  }

  const zones = current.zone_summary || {};
  const pairs = Object.entries(zones);
  if (!pairs.length) {
    host.append(panel("Zone Analysis", empty(
      "No zone pairs resolved",
      "Rule addresses did not match any configured zone subnet. Adjust zone_config.json to describe this network."
    )));
    return;
  }

  // Pairs arrive as "src → dst"; split them back out into a matrix.
  const sources = [...new Set(pairs.map(([k]) => k.split("→")[0].trim()))].sort();
  const dests = [...new Set(pairs.map(([k]) => k.split("→")[1].trim()))].sort();
  const lookup = new Map(pairs.map(([k, v]) => [k.replace(/\s*→\s*/, "→"), v]));
  const peak = Math.max(...pairs.map(([, v]) => v.total_rules), 1);

  const table = el("div", { class: "table-wrap" },
    el("table", { class: "data" }, [
      el("thead", {}, el("tr", {}, [
        el("th", {}, "From \\ To"),
        ...dests.map((d) => el("th", { class: "num" }, d)),
      ])),
      el("tbody", {}, sources.map((src) =>
        el("tr", {}, [
          el("td", { class: "rule-name" }, src),
          ...dests.map((dst) => {
            const cell = lookup.get(`${src}→${dst}`);
            if (!cell) return el("td", { class: "num muted" }, "—");
            // One hue, opacity carries magnitude — a sequential job.
            const alpha = 0.12 + (cell.total_rules / peak) * 0.55;
            return el("td", {
              class: "num",
              style: `background:rgba(208,74,2,${alpha.toFixed(2)});font-weight:650`,
              title: `${cell.allow_rules} allow · ${cell.deny_rules} deny`,
            }, fmtNumber(cell.total_rules));
          }),
        ])
      )),
    ])
  );

  host.append(panel("Zone Traffic Matrix", table, {
    sub: `${pairs.length} zone pairs · cell shade is rule count`,
  }));

  const rows = pairs
    .sort((a, b) => b[1].total_rules - a[1].total_rules)
    .map(([pair, v]) => el("tr", {}, [
      el("td", { class: "rule-name" }, pair),
      el("td", { class: "num" }, fmtNumber(v.total_rules)),
      el("td", { class: "num" }, el("span", { class: "pill allow" }, v.allow_rules)),
      el("td", { class: "num" }, el("span", { class: "pill deny" }, v.deny_rules)),
    ]));

  host.append(el("div", { style: "height:1rem" }));
  host.append(panel("Zone Pairs", el("div", { class: "table-wrap" },
    el("table", { class: "data" }, [
      el("thead", {}, el("tr", {}, [
        el("th", {}, "Pair"), el("th", { class: "num" }, "Rules"),
        el("th", { class: "num" }, "Allow"), el("th", { class: "num" }, "Deny"),
      ])),
      el("tbody", {}, rows),
    ])
  )));
}
```

## `tools/check_browsing_profiles.py`

```python
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# ==========================================================
# Remove old output files before creating new ones
# ==========================================================

for file_name in [
    "OUTPUT_all_protected_channel_rules.csv",
    "OUTPUT_FLAGGED_no_profile.csv"
]:
    path = Path(file_name)
    if path.exists():
        path.unlink()

# ==========================================================
# Load CSV / Excel
# ==========================================================

input_file = sys.argv[1] 

if input_file.lower().endswith((".xlsx", ".xls")):
    df = pd.read_excel(input_file)
else:
    df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

print(f"Loaded {len(df)} rules from: {input_file}")

# ==========================================================
# Find Security Profile column
# ==========================================================

profile_col = None

for col in df.columns:
    if "profile" in str(col).lower():
        profile_col = col
        break

# ==========================================================
# Browsing definitions
# ==========================================================

BROWSING_SERVICES = {
    "http",
    "https",
    "service-http",
    "service-https",
    "tcp-80",
    "tcp_80",
    "tcp_80_http",
    "tcp-443",
    "tcp_443",
    "tcp_443_tls",
}

BROWSING_APPS = {
    "web-browsing",
    "ssl",
}

# ==========================================================
# Management definitions
# ==========================================================

MANAGEMENT_SERVICES = {
    "ssh",
    "tcp-22",
    "tcp_22_ssh",
    "tcp-3389",
    "tcp_3389_rdp",
    "tcp-5985",
    "tcp-5986",
}

MANAGEMENT_APPS = {
    "ssh",
    "ms-rdp",
    "winrm",
}

# ==========================================================
# Helpers
# ==========================================================

def contains_token(value, valid_tokens):
    for token in str(value).split(";"):
        if token.strip().lower() in valid_tokens:
            return True
    return False


def has_profile(value):
    return str(value).strip().lower() not in (
        "",
        "none",
        "nan",
        "-"
    )

# ==========================================================
# Detect Browsing Rules
# ==========================================================

df["Browsing_Service"] = df["Service"].apply(
    lambda x: contains_token(x, BROWSING_SERVICES)
)

df["Browsing_App"] = df["Application"].apply(
    lambda x: contains_token(x, BROWSING_APPS)
)

# ==========================================================
# Detect Management Rules
# ==========================================================

df["Management_Service"] = df["Service"].apply(
    lambda x: contains_token(x, MANAGEMENT_SERVICES)
)

df["Management_App"] = df["Application"].apply(
    lambda x: contains_token(x, MANAGEMENT_APPS)
)

# ==========================================================
# Protected Channels
# ==========================================================

df["Protected_Channel"] = (
    df["Browsing_Service"]
    |
    df["Browsing_App"]
    |
    df["Management_Service"]
    |
    df["Management_App"]
)

# ==========================================================
# Enabled Rules Only
# ==========================================================

df["Enabled"] = ~df["Action"].astype(str).str.lower().str.contains(
    r"\[disabled\]"
)

protected_rules = df[
    (df["Protected_Channel"]) &
    (df["Enabled"])
].copy()

print(f"Protected channel rules found: {len(protected_rules)}")

# ==========================================================
# Security Profile Check
# ==========================================================

if profile_col is None:

    print("\nNo Security Profile column found.")

    protected_rules.to_csv(
        "OUTPUT_all_protected_channel_rules.csv",
        index=False
    )

    print("Saved OUTPUT_all_protected_channel_rules.csv")

    sys.exit(0)

protected_rules["HasProfile"] = protected_rules[
    profile_col
].apply(has_profile)

flagged = protected_rules[
    ~protected_rules["HasProfile"]
].copy()

# ==========================================================
# Save Outputs
# ==========================================================

protected_rules.to_csv(
    "OUTPUT_all_protected_channel_rules.csv",
    index=False
)

flagged.to_csv(
    "OUTPUT_FLAGGED_no_profile.csv",
    index=False
)

# ==========================================================
# Summary
# ==========================================================

print("-" * 60)
print(f"Protected channel rules: {len(protected_rules)}")
print(f"Missing Security Profile: {len(flagged)}")
print("-" * 60)

print("Saved OUTPUT_all_protected_channel_rules.csv")
print("Saved OUTPUT_FLAGGED_no_profile.csv")
```
